baseline_exposure_offset_note: Measured on a Q7 DNG and the camera JPEG stored in it (firmware 1.01, ISO 100, Landscape): the model meets the JPEG's six grey patches at +0.03 to +0.06 EV over the sensor level, and the DNG carries BaselineExposure -0.5, as K-3 Mark III files do. See docs/chart-session-validation.json.

mode_label_sources.note: Custom Image names as in the K-3 Mark III pack; the firmware names them Natural, Vivid, Portrait, Landscape, Miyabi, PopTune, Honoka, BleachBypass, Reversal and Monotone.
